name: Debits equal credits
description: Total debits must equal total credits (within a tolerance).

name: No duplicate accounts
description: An account code should appear once in a trial balance.

name: Accounts are identified
description: Every row needs both an account code and an account name.

name: One side per account
description: An account line should not carry both a debit and a credit.

name: No negative debit/credit amounts
description: Debit and credit columns should hold positive amounts.

name: Balances sit on their usual side
description: Flags accounts whose balance is on the opposite side to what their account number range suggests (assumes standard 1xxx-8xxx numbering).

name: Extraction is complete
description: Flags unreadable amounts and a sheet total row that disagrees with the rows read.

name: Plausible size
description: Flags very small or all-zero trial balances.
